notes:
# The phone stays connected {wave}
The connection your phone reaches this Mac through could be dropped and
left down, and nothing here noticed — the phone said "Reconnecting" and
the Mac looked fine. This Mac now puts it back by itself, whether or not
the app is open.

---

Everything else in this release:

- When it cannot be put back, the Mac says so in its log instead of
  leaving you to work out why the phone is quiet.
